name: Hong Kong — Kam Tin Driving Test
description: 3.445 km Kam Tin solo test, v0.5 reference-informed visual pass. Route Twisk RWE/Repack is the quality target, not an achieved quality claim. New alpha-cut foliage, photographed asphalt/ground textures and authored W-beam safety rails/posts/reflectors. Reference assets were inspected read-only, not copied. Original driving/collision payloads and spawns retained; coarse test-wall collision remains behind visual rails. Road/junction widths, kerbs and roadside fidelity remain provisional. Daytime Practice, one car, no AI. Engine appearance/FPS await the user. Map from Lands Department; source data © Government of the Hong Kong SAR, https://3d.map.gov.hk/ . Roads © OpenStreetMap contributors. Additional textures: Poly Haven CC0.
author: HK 1:1 Project
